title: The Episode About Baba Banda And Bahadur Shah S

blocks.text: Bahadur Shah sends disguised scouts to test the wildest miracle stories, asking whether Banda’s feet leave marks, whether he casts a shadow, and whether his body behaves like an ordinary man’s.
The spies return reporting that he does indeed leave signs of humanity, which trims the outer edge of rumor without reducing the fear he inspires.
The emperor’s policy shifts from passive dread to measured surveillance once the question of whether Banda’s feet leave marks is posed and answered.
